claim: Protected branches, including the requirement of a pull request with approving reviews, are available on public repositories on GitHub Free. GitHub's protected-branches page ties bypass lists and push restrictions to organization-owned repositories, and it does not describe exempting a specific user or app from the pull-request requirement on a personal-account repository. The same page does not say whether the github-actions bot can push to a protected branch. So for a personal repository, no safe plan may assume the daily poster's bot can push to a protected main.
